defects.description: The term 'safe value' is mistranslated as 'безопасного замечания' (safe remark/note). In this technical context, 'value' should be 'значение'.
The term 'applied defaults' is mistranslated as 'применённые замечания по умолчанию' (applied remarks by default). 'Defaults' should be 'значения по умолчанию'.
The phrase 'analytical-task reviews' is translated as 'анализ-задачи, отзывы', which is grammatically incorrect and awkward in Russian.
The phrase 'explicitly set' is mistranslated as 'явно задача' (explicitly task), which completely changes the meaning of the technical requirement.
The term 'never inferred' is mistranslated as 'никогда не выводится' (never outputted/printed). 'Inferred' in the context of parameter defaults means 'deduced' or 'implied'.
Grammatical error: the glossary term 'Роль' is used in the nominative case instead of the required genitive case ('роли') to indicate possession ('the role's base prompt template').
